name: Lynden Pindling International Airport

hours.v: the airport operates 24/7; individual services and counters have their own hours
hours.quote: LPIA operates 24/7, but specific services and counters have varying hours of operation.

handling.v: the airport's private flight page names two FBOs: Odyssey Aviation and Jet Nassau
handling.quote: Odyssey Aviation is a network of privately owned FBOs and Ground Handling Service Stations

runway.v: Runway 14/32, 10,925 ft x 150 ft (3,330 m x 46 m), asphalt. The airport has a second, intersecting runway that this register does not list, so its length is unknown (register based on Bahamas AIP 5th edition, AMDT 01/2022; a newer edition exists).

permits.v: Commercial charter into or from The Bahamas needs an Annual Licence from Air Transport Licensing or, for operations less than 2 times in 30 days, an Ad-Hoc Approval Permit. A flight not for gainful consideration needs no permit
permits.quote: Apply for an Ad-Hoc Approval Permit granted the operation occurs less than 2 times within a 30-day period.

notes: No Bahamas AIP (AD 2 MYNN) could be found online from an official Bahamian source. Read the Nassau Airport Development Company site (FAQs; Private Flight Services, modified 2 May 2025; Customs & Immigration page, modified 26 Feb 2026, gives no hours for private flights). The FAA IFIM Bahamas page (dated 1 Nov 2014) was read but not used because it is out of date. The FAQ gives terminal security hours (06:00-22:00) for passengers, not customs hours for private aircraft. Owner should obtain the Bahamas AIP from the Bahamas Civil Aviation Authority / Air Navigation Services Division. 1 Nov 2026: searched again for a Bahamas AIP (Bahamas CAA, caabahamas.com): none found online. nassaulpia.com Developments page (modified 5 Jun 2025) says 'Two Intersecting Runways' but gives no lengths, so runway stays missing. FAA IFIM Bahamas page still dated 1 Nov 2014 (says MYNN open H24 and PPR 48 h for private flights outside published hours) - not used, out of date. Owner should obtain the AD 2 MYNN pages from the Bahamas CAA. | 3 Nov 2026: read the CAA Bahamas government aerodrome register (undated, data from AIP Fifth Edition AMDT 01/2022; the CAA's private register cites a newer Seventh Edition AMDT 01/2024, so check runway and fuel against the current AIP). longest_m is the one runway listed; it was converted from feet (x 0.3048). The row also shows '24HRS' and port of entry 'YES', with neither column defined, so customs hours are not recorded. Runway 14/32 was rehabilitated (NAD release 26 Mar 2025); no length given. The FAQ does not mention foreign operators specifically; it gives ad-hoc processing as 3 hours on weekdays (applications 09:00-14:00) and 6 hours on weekends and holidays. Still no AD 2 MYNN found online. 5 Nov 2026: no field filled, but read Bahamas Customs. Private Aircraft Declarations (modified 6 Apr 2026): 'Other aircraft must be reported on the General Declaration Form No C7.'; Form C7A is for 'private aircraft not carrying cargo and operated for pleasure and recreation only', so a paid charter is likely C7 (not stated); 'This process must be completed within 24 hours after arrival into The Bahamas.'; 'No passengers or crew are to disembark until process is completed.' Customs Offices & Ports (modified 15 Sep 2026) lists LPIA and general aviation phone lines but no hours, so customs hours not verified. CAR FAL Rev 02 (1 Mar 2023) s.2.6 says prior authorisation and advance notice rules are published in the AIP; s.2.6.12 treats flight plan information received at least 2 hours before arrival as adequate notice when landing at a designated international airport (read in part through a tool summary; the AIP is what applies). Still no AD 2 MYNN online. | 7 Nov 2026: nothing new. bahamas.com/vfr (private pilot page, no publisher or date shown, Covid-era text) says customs normal hours 9:00am-5:30pm 'check with the airport for specific hours', not airport specific; not recorded. Still no Bahamas AIP AD 2 MYNN online; searches on caabahamas.com found none.
